headline: RapWire 24/7: Rod Wave, Badu, Rihanna and GTA VI
caption:
1) Rod Wave (@RodWave) was indicted by a Fulton County grand jury on one count each of reckless driving, possession of a Schedule II controlled substance and possession of a firearm during the commission of certain felonies, stemming from a November 2025 Atlanta traffic stop. He was not in custody on Nov. 18 and is scheduled to perform at State Farm Arena this week while the case moves forward.

2) Erykah Badu will direct the 2026 Badu Cypher at the Soul Train Awards, bringing Rapsody, CeeLo Green, Dave Hollister and Avery Wilson together for the showcase. The ceremony is scheduled for Nov. 27 on BET and CBS, making the lineup a cross-generational spotlight for soul, R&B and hip-hop. @erykahbadu @Rapsody

3) Rihanna and her one-year-old daughter Rocki star together in Dior’s Lady Dior 2027 campaign, with creative direction by Jonathan Anderson and images by Sam Rock. It is Rocki’s first campaign and extends Rihanna’s long-running fashion presence into a new mother-daughter chapter. @rihanna

4) Rockstar’s official Grand Theft Auto VI credits identify Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos and Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval, finally confirming the actors behind the game’s central couple. The same credits also name performers including Bobby Moynihan, Stephen Root, Taryn Manning, Roselyn Sanchez and Denzel Curry, turning launch-day mystery into public record. @RockstarGames

5) Cardi B is hosting a launch-night party in Miami, while she and Travis Scott are set to headline Saturday’s GTA VI Music Festival with Justice, Don Toliver and Metro Boomin. Travis will also host the official after-party, extending the game’s release into a real-world music weekend in Vice City country. @iamcardib @trvisXX

@Rapwire247
